locked_conventions.physical_interval: I_lambda=[-log(lambda),log(lambda)] with L=2*log(lambda), Lebesgue measure, and zero extension
locked_conventions.source_interval: [-lambda,lambda] with Lebesgue measure and zero extension
locked_conventions.source_normalization: h_lambda=a_4*h_(4,lambda)-a_(0,lambda)*h_(0,lambda), with fixed source a_4 and h_lambda tending to h; unit norm is rejected

locked_formulas.minimum_graph_spill: Gamma_min^2=tr(D*U_M^*(R_M^dagger-P_ran(R_M))*U_M), provided ran(U_M) is contained in ran(R_M)
locked_formulas.central_rate_target: epsilon_lambda/gamma_lambda=o(1/lambda); M=ceil(lambda*L) makes every non-graph central term o(lambda^(-1/2))
locked_formulas.annular_prime_profile: S_lambda(z/L)=2*lambda*cos(z)+o(lambda), uniformly for z in compact sets
locked_formulas.annular_defect_profile: d_all(z/L)=4*lambda*cos(z)+o(lambda) for abs(z)<pi/2; d_ext agrees when abs(z)>delta
locked_formulas.gray_mass: A_lambda*chi_X>=c*lambda in each inversion parity for a fixed annulus delta<a<b<pi/2
locked_formulas.one_projector_cost: an O(L) operator budget requires Omega(lambda/L) top soft directions; on N_star=O(L^2) the theorem eventually requires the full target
locked_formulas.annular_angle: an O(L) exterior budget requires squared angle O(L/lambda) to a fixed closed annular concentration projector
locked_formulas.hard_cut_layer: only for d_ext, the two reflected cutoff jumps force the full-interval layer average to be Omega(lambda)
locked_formulas.odd_complete_form: G_lambda=P_lambda+A_lambda with the negative odd pole, complete minus-prime block, and archimedean block combined
locked_formulas.one_sided_limsup: unconditionally limsup F(X)/sqrt(X)>=0; if a zero lies right of 1/2 then the limsup is positive infinity
locked_formulas.locked_odd_subsequence: limsup over locked lambda of G_lambda/lambda>=c0; infinitely many locked lambda have G_lambda>(c0/2)*lambda
locked_formulas.finite_odd_projection: a non-effective source-selectable diagonal N_j transfers the pole-axis Rayleigh lower bound alpha_j>=3*c0/4
locked_formulas.remaining_odd_schur: for beta=c0/4, still require C_beta>0 and <b,C_beta^(-1)b><c0/2

claim_boundary.central_result: exact tangent/spill characterization and a sufficient relative source ratio, not the actual prescribed-family rate
claim_boundary.exterior_result: a no-go theorem for the present global gray/BV route and a necessary annular angle, not actual multi-column misalignment
claim_boundary.odd_result: an unconditional favorable locked subsequence and qualitative pole-axis finite projection, not the transverse harmonic short
